identity.name: Linear
identity.tagline: The Issue Tracker Built for High-Performance Teams

voice.personality: Linear speaks with crisp precision, confidence, and quiet authority. It reflects a brand obsessed with speed, craft, and high performance, appealing directly to modern software builders who despise administrative clutter.

positioning.differentiator: Blazing-fast, keyboard-driven issue tracking designed with opinionated, modern workflows that keep software teams in flow state.

audience.primary: Software engineers, product managers, and design leaders at high-growth tech companies.
painPoints: Slow, bloated legacy trackers like Jira that disrupt developer focus
Disconnection between daily task execution and high-level product roadmaps
motivations: Maintaining flow state through instant UI responses and shortcut-driven navigation
Shipping high-quality software updates faster with streamlined processes

selectedConcept.hook: Still losing 15+ hours every week to manual linear tasks?
selectedConcept.narrative: Confronts developer frustration with fragile legacy scripts, demonstrates Linear automating the entire pipeline in milliseconds, and seals conversion with enterprise compliance.
selectedConcept.emotionalArc: High Friction → Instant Relief → Confident Control
selectedConcept.visualMood: Dark glassmorphic canvas with pulsing warning badges resolving to brand glow.
selectedConcept.reasoning: Pain-driven hooks consistently achieve the highest 3-second hold rate on social feeds.

storyboard.pacingStrategy: Aggressive glitch tension (3s), ultra-fluid mechanical precision (4s), solid metric anchor (4s), high-urgency minimal CTA (4s)

scenes.name: The Legacy Pain Hook
scenes.intent: Agitate deep developer frustration with legacy pipeline fragility and lost hours
scenes.headlineCopy: Still losing 15+ hours every week to manual linear tasks?
scenes.supportingCopy: Fragile bash scripts • Broken builds • Silent failures
scenes.visualDescription: Dark charcoal background (#0B0C0E) with subtle red warning terminal code flickering in the background. Kinetic typography punches in frame-by-frame with high contrast, echoing developer screen fatigue.
scenes.pacingNotes: Rapid glitch cuts and sharp typography staggers in 4-frame increments

elementIntents.description: Flickering error red terminal logs behind text

scenes.name: The Linear Solution
scenes.intent: Demonstrate effortless, instant pipeline automation using Linear's aesthetic design system
scenes.headlineCopy: Automate your entire cycle in milliseconds.
scenes.visualDescription: Smooth visual transition into Linear brand purple ambient lighting (#5E6AD2). Chaotic terminal text collapses seamlessly into a pristine, high-speed Linear issue board where task cards snap into completed state automatically.
scenes.pacingNotes: Fluid motion curves with high frame-rate spring physics

elementIntents.description: Sleek glowing white headline floating over interface

scenes.name: The Velocity & Trust Proof
scenes.intent: Anchor performance gains with concrete metric proof and enterprise security assurances
scenes.supportingCopy: SOC2 Type II Certified • Enterprise Security Built-In
scenes.visualDescription: Massive minimalist dynamic typographic metric '10x' scales up smoothly with a subtle purple backlight aura. Clean enterprise compliance shield badges lock down below the metric.
scenes.pacingNotes: Hard visual impact lock on '10x', settling into a micro-pulsing hold

elementIntents.description: Minimalist SOC2 and Enterprise security indicators

scenes.name: The High-Velocity Call to Action
scenes.intent: Drive immediate conversion with a pristine, high-urgency minimalist close
scenes.visualDescription: Ultra-clean layout. Linear mark radiating a subtle pulse in brand purple (#5E6AD2). Sharp white CTA button snaps to center screen with interactive glowing hover ring.
scenes.pacingNotes: Wipe transition to focused stillness with subtle CTA pulse animation

elementIntents.description: Interactive CTA button in Linear purple accent
